Sophia Chen: Hey @Lisa (People Ops) — I need to request a recurring accommodation for weekly therapy during work hours. Prefer Tuesdays 11:00-12:00. Can People Ops help reserve a private space and advise on the paperwork? I'd like this to be confidential.

Lisa (People Ops): Hi Sophia — we can help. Quick Qs: 1) Wellness Pod ok? 2) Want the ADA request link or to submit a provider note? We can mark events private on the calendar. :slightly_smiling_face: 

Sophia Chen: Wellness Pod works. Please send the form. I really want minimal visibility on team calendars.

Mike R.: @Sophia Chen happy to move my recurring 11:30 sync off that slot — no problem. Tues 11 ok? I can shift to Wed or make it async while you settle in.

Lisa (People Ops): Sending intake link: https://intra.redwood/hr/ada-request — you can submit a short note or attach a provider note. For intermittent visits we sometimes handle things informally but we'll open a confidential accommodation case. We only share what managers need to know to allow schedule adjustments. :lock: 

Sophia Chen: Thanks. One worry — will this show up in performance conversations or my review?

Lisa (People Ops): It shouldn't. Requesting an accommodation is confidential and protected; it won't be used against you. If there are separate performance concerns, we'll handle those independently and offer support. If helpful we can add a neutral note to the manager so they don't conflate things.

hrbot: [Automated] Accommodation intake submitted for Sophia Chen. Case ID: HR-2026-045. People Ops will follow up within 2 business days.

Jamie O.: I'll take care of the room booking. Tentatively reserving Wellness Pod 2 every Tue 11:00-12:00 from next week through 2026-06-30 and marking the invites as "Private — Appointment". If Sophia prefers a different spot, we can change. Sample event title: 
`````
Private — Appointment (People Ops)
`````
I'll add People Ops as attendee for scheduling only. No notes recorded.

Mike R.: Thanks Jamie. Sophia — I'll cancel my recurring 11:30 once Lisa confirms so you have clear time.

Sophia Chen: I filled the form and attached a brief provider note. Please keep case confidential. If possible Id like a small workload adjustment for the first month while I start therapy.

Lisa (People Ops): Got it — confidentiality maintained. Case HR-2026-045 updated. I'll schedule an optional 15-min check-in to finalize logistics. We can coordinate a temporary shift in task deadlines with Mike for the first month.

Jamie O.: Wellness Pod 2 is booked Tue 11:00-12:00 (private series). Calendar invites sent as private. Case HR-2026-045 tagged in the booking.

Sophia Chen: Thank you all — really appreciate the support. :heart:
